title: Ask HN: what is the worst error message you have shipped?
text:
Ask HN: what is the worst error message you have shipped?

runa_ok: I keep a running list of the worst error messages I have shipped, and the current leader is the string operation completed printed after a failure, which survived in production for eleven months.

The thread is long. Several people argue that the fix is to make every error carry the file name; several others argue that the fix is to stop writing errors that one machine wrote for another machine.

Posted 19 August 2025. On the same day runa_ok posted a short comment describing how the Quarrystone team writes error messages in pairs, one for the person and one for the log.
